footerText: Innovative advertising & printing solutions since 2010 — now serving Central Asia.
desAbout: Since 2010, our company has been offering innovative solutions in the advertising and printing industry in Turkey. We are continuously improving ourselves to provide services that best meet the needs of our clients. In 2022, we took our international growth a step further by establishing a modern factory in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, occupying a 2000 m² area. With our new production base, we aim to bring our high-quality manufacturing and prompt service approach to the Central Asian market, delivering professional advertising solutions to our clients in the region. Backed by a strong infrastructure and an experienced team, we always prioritize customer satisfaction and strive to play a leading role in the industry. If you have any questions or would like to learn more, feel free to contact us!

wayfinding-signage.subtitle: Clear navigation systems for large facilities
wayfinding-signage.intro: We design and manufacture wayfinding signage systems that help visitors navigate hotels, hospitals, business centers and public buildings with ease. Every system is engineered for clarity, consistency and durability.
wayfinding-signage.materials: Aluminum, acrylic, stainless steel and digitally printed panels, produced in-house at our 2,000 m² factory in Tashkent.
wayfinding-signage.capability: From concept design to production and on-site installation, our team manages the full wayfinding project.

hotel-signage.subtitle: Guest navigation and branding for hospitality projects
hotel-signage.intro: MGA Reklama manufactures room number plates, floor directories, elevator signage and full hotel wayfinding systems that match your brand identity and elevate the guest experience.
hotel-signage.materials: Brushed metal, brass-effect finishes, acrylic and illuminated panels.
hotel-signage.capability: We work directly with hotel operators and interior designers, delivering consistent signage across every floor and public area.

interior-signage.subtitle: Branded signage for offices, retail and public interiors
interior-signage.intro: We produce interior signage — reception signs, office directories, wall graphics and branded panels — that reflect your company's identity indoors.
interior-signage.materials: Acrylic, PVC, metal composite and printed vinyl finishes.
interior-signage.capability: Custom sizes and finishes are manufactured to order and installed by our own team.

outdoor-signage.subtitle: Durable exterior advertising built to withstand the elements
outdoor-signage.intro: From storefront signs to large-scale outdoor advertising structures, we design and manufacture outdoor signage engineered for Uzbekistan's climate and built to last.
outdoor-signage.materials: Weatherproof metal, acrylic, LED illumination and digitally printed surfaces.
outdoor-signage.capability: Our factory handles structural engineering, production and installation for outdoor projects of any scale.

totem-pylon-signs.subtitle: Freestanding structures for maximum visibility
totem-pylon-signs.intro: Totem and pylon signs give businesses, shopping centers and fuel stations strong roadside visibility. We engineer and build freestanding structures from the ground up.
totem-pylon-signs.materials: Steel frames, aluminum cladding, acrylic faces and LED lighting.
totem-pylon-signs.capability: Structural design, fabrication, transport and installation are all handled by our team.

channel-letters.subtitle: Illuminated dimensional lettering for storefronts
channel-letters.intro: Channel letters give brands a premium, three-dimensional presence. We manufacture front-lit and back-lit letters in custom sizes for storefronts, facades and interiors.
channel-letters.materials: Aluminum, acrylic faces and LED modules.
channel-letters.capability: Every set of letters is custom-fabricated and installed by our production team.

large-format-printing.subtitle: High-resolution printing for banners, wraps and displays
large-format-printing.intro: Our large format printing services cover banners, vehicle wraps, building wraps and exhibition graphics — produced in-house for fast turnaround.
large-format-printing.materials: Vinyl, mesh banner, canvas and rigid substrates.
large-format-printing.capability: In-house printing and finishing lets us deliver large runs quickly without third-party delays.

museum-signage.subtitle: Interpretive and wayfinding signage for cultural institutions
museum-signage.intro: We manufacture interpretive panels, exhibit labels and wayfinding signage for museums and cultural spaces, balancing durability with refined presentation.
museum-signage.materials: Acrylic, printed panels, metal frames and UV-stable finishes.
museum-signage.capability: We coordinate closely with curators and exhibition designers on custom installations.

facade-signage.subtitle: Building-mounted and rooftop signage for maximum brand visibility
facade-signage.intro: Facade and rooftop signage puts your brand on the skyline. We design, engineer and install building-mounted signs sized for visibility from a distance.
facade-signage.materials: Aluminum composite panels, illuminated letters and structural steel mounts.
facade-signage.capability: Our engineering team ensures every installation meets structural and safety requirements.

fit-out-interior-works.subtitle: Complete interior build-out for retail and commercial spaces
fit-out-interior-works.intro: Beyond signage, MGA Reklama delivers full interior fit-out services — from partitions and cladding to custom joinery — for retail and commercial spaces.
fit-out-interior-works.materials: Metal framing, plexiglass, laminates and custom millwork.
fit-out-interior-works.capability: One team manages design, production and installation, so fit-out projects stay on one schedule.

projects.listIntro: A closer look at completed signage and advertising production projects — real project pages are added here as work is completed.

sample-hotel-wayfinding.name: Sample Project — Hotel Wayfinding
sample-hotel-wayfinding.workDone: Full wayfinding system including room number plates, floor directories and elevator signage, matched to the hotel's brand identity.
sample-hotel-wayfinding.materials: Brushed metal, acrylic and illuminated panels.

sample-outdoor-facade-signage.name: Sample Project — Facade & Outdoor Signage
sample-outdoor-facade-signage.workDone: Design, manufacturing and installation of illuminated facade signage and channel letters for a retail storefront.
sample-outdoor-facade-signage.materials: Aluminum composite panels, channel letters and LED illumination.

uv-printing.short: Direct UV printing on rigid and flexible materials.
uv-printing.intro: Our UV printers apply ink directly onto rigid and flexible surfaces — acrylic, PVC, wood, glass and metal — curing it instantly with UV light for a durable, scratch-resistant finish.
uv-printing.capability: Ideal for signage panels, decorative wall art, promotional displays and any project that needs full-color printing directly onto a rigid material without laminating a separate print.

interior-printing.short: Interior-grade printing for indoor branding and decor.
interior-printing.intro: We produce interior printing for office branding, retail decor, wall graphics and wayfinding elements, using materials and inks suited for indoor use.
interior-printing.capability: Suitable for reception walls, meeting room graphics, retail interior branding and decorative panels.

outdoor-printing.intro: Our outdoor printing uses weather-resistant inks and substrates designed to withstand sun, rain and temperature changes without fading or peeling.
outdoor-printing.capability: Used for billboards, storefront graphics, banners and any outdoor-facing branded surface.

metal-laser-cutting-machine.short: Precision laser cutting for metal components.
metal-laser-cutting-machine.intro: Our metal laser cutting machine cuts precise shapes and lettering out of steel, aluminum and other metals, giving clean edges without manual finishing.
metal-laser-cutting-machine.capability: Used for channel letters, metal signage frames, decorative metal panels and custom brackets.

cnc-cutting.short: CNC-routed panels and shapes to exact dimensions.
cnc-cutting.intro: Our CNC cutting equipment routs acrylic, wood, foam and composite panels to precise dimensions, producing consistent, repeatable shapes for large orders.
cnc-cutting.capability: Used for sign faces, dimensional letters, display stands and custom-shaped panels.

laser-plexiglass-machine.intro: Our laser plexiglass machine cuts and engraves acrylic sheets with clean, polished edges, suitable for both flat and illuminated signage.
laser-plexiglass-machine.capability: Used for acrylic letters, light boxes, engraved plaques and decorative acrylic elements.

letter-bending-machine.intro: Our letter bending machine shapes metal and acrylic strips into the precise profiles used for three-dimensional channel letters and border trim.
letter-bending-machine.capability: Used to build the sides (returns) of channel letters and custom dimensional lettering.

laser-welding.short: Precision welding for clean, durable metal joints.
laser-welding.intro: Our laser welding equipment joins metal components with narrow, precise welds that need little to no finishing, keeping surfaces smooth for painting or plating.
laser-welding.capability: Used to assemble channel letters, metal frames and structural signage components.

plotter-cutting.short: Vinyl cutting for lettering, decals and graphics.
plotter-cutting.intro: Our plotter cutting equipment cuts self-adhesive vinyl into precise letters, logos and graphics for application to vehicles, windows and signage.
plotter-cutting.capability: Used for vehicle wraps, window graphics, cut vinyl lettering and decals.
